purpose: Stage 0.5 item 6, variant round (user decisions 2026-11-18): the Agent column on the 13 A_static instances, now able to answer a failed grasp with a grasp variant: at most 4 recipe keys overridden inside the frozen recipe envelope (adaptive_reuse_grasp CATEGORY_KEYS, _validate), bound at configuration, so the episode restarts with the variant (harness/agent_column.py agent-column-p3-g0-vary-20261118, kernel.agent_episode). The brain also sees the robot-side diagnosis of a failed node (planned route; after a guard the touched link, the touched role and the palm position) and the K3 answer and fit behind each locate. Brain GPT-6.2 Astra via Magpie with reasoning effort high. No graph change: variants stay in their branches as candidates.
instance_note: Same generate spec and seeds as A_static (replicates), so prepare rebuilds the same 18 instances and the same 13 ready ones; ready rows and initial hashes are compared with A_static after prepare.

baselines.negative: 2 s wait on the first ready instance of each template under hand rule v2; any goal satisfaction invalidates the whole batch
baselines.retry: outputs/tabletop_retry_20261118_001 (Astra, default reasoning, retries only): first pass 2/13, after retries 2/13; 11 failed instances, 13 branches, every relocated estimate within 0.5 mm
baselines.agent_static: outputs/tabletop_astatic_20261117_001 agent column (DeepSeek v4.1 flash, no retry, a guard ended the episode): 2/13 full success (TP01 2/5, TP03 0/2, TP04 0/6)
baselines.aids: the guard diagnosis comes from the plant's own guard record (contact bodies named by public role) and is reported as an aid with every success

caps_note: Budgets as the retry round (user decision): 2 forks shared by retries and variants, 12 brain calls per episode. A variant branch is a new episode of the case, so its simulation, command and wall budgets restart; a retry branch's carry over from its source.
budget_note: 3 negatives + 13 ready instances x 1 arm; a retry branch is part of its episode, not a new physical episode.
prediction: No system failure, no KERNEL_CHANGED_AFTER_PREPARE, negatives 3/3 not satisfied; the 13 ready instances and their robot initial hashes equal A_static's.
Cross-run determinism: every first pass whose executed node path equals the retry round's has physical records equal to it.

The brain answers at least 6 of the 8 guard stops in grasp (translate_clear x4, approach x4) with a variant, and every variant changes a key whose stage is the failed one or earlier (prepare for translate_clear; preflight or approach for the approach stops).
translate_clear (cup and bottle, clear point 15 cm over the table above the target): a variant gets past prepare on at least 2 of the 4 instances.
Approach stops (TP04 fruit): a variant gets past approach_open on at least 1 of the 4 instances.
Full success after variants: between 2 and 5 of 13 (first pass 2; at most 3 more, from TP01 or TP03 past prepare; TP04 place has never been reached).
At most 1 AgentSchemaError, no BRAIN_CALL_BUDGET; every episode's last branch ends with stop.
falsification: Negative control satisfies a goal, or any system failure: the whole batch is invalid.
A first pass with the retry round's node path but different physical records: hidden state or nondeterminism; variant results are not used until the cause is found.
Any BRAIN_CALL_BUDGET or more than 1 AgentSchemaError: the variant prompt or schema is not usable as is; reported, not fixed inside this run.

No variant gets past the stage it targeted on any of the 8 guard stops: bounded recipe variants do not reach this frontier; the next step is a code-level leaf or a kernel gap (for example obstacle perception), not more parameter search.
interpretation: A variant success is a candidate from the brain's recovery (origin brain_recovery, aided by the guard diagnosis); it enters the graph only through the evidence gate on other instances (§2.1 step 6), which this run does not perform.
